confidence_notes: A Paracas guide reports set lunches at PEN 14–18 and pisco sours at PEN 18–22; Numbeo meal, beer, and coffee prices are Peru-wide. Hostel averages are reported before taxes and fees, and accommodation prices vary. Wine is estimated at about twice the local draft-beer anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used. Paracas-specific food and lodging data were supplemented with Peru-wide Numbeo prices where local price data were unavailable.
